column1: # LLM-down evaluation set (kk). status: draft (every case below).

# lang is the member's language. Lines starting with '#' are comments.
# crisis: the fixed crisis response and an escalation, whatever the provider does
# fallback: an ordinary question gets the degraded reply, never an error
